name: Astera Labs
thesis: PCIe/CXL retimers and switches ride AI rack scale-out; Scorpio X switches seen above $1B annual run rate by end-2026 (BMO conf).
risks: High valuation, customer concentration, and swings after hours (-3.4% AH Nov 11).
catalyst: Scorpio X ramp; Nvidia CEO change may help non-Nvidia rack designs.

name: Advanced Micro Devices
thesis: Instinct GPUs gaining as second source; Huang exit from Nvidia may open share; BofA target $700, William Blair upgrade to Outperform.
risks: Up about 10% in two days on Nvidia turmoil, so the move may be stretched; new PsiQuantum equity stake adds spend.
catalyst: Anthropic IPO Nov 19; customers reassessing Nvidia after CEO exit.

name: Broadcom
thesis: Custom AI accelerators (Google TPU, Anthropic) plus networking; up about 5% Nov 12 as buyers rotate from Nvidia after Huang resigned.
risks: Concentration in hyperscaler XPU programs; AI capex scare like the Nov 5 SOX -12% day.

name: Celestica
thesis: Builds racks and switches for custom-ASIC hyperscalers; Bernstein still Outperform.
risks: Bernstein cut its target to $340 from $495; low margins; hyperscaler concentration.

name: SK Hynix (000660)
thesis: HBM leader; memory rallied after CoreWeave Q3 and KOSPI rose 2.6% Nov 11.
risks: Memory cycle peak worries; momentum fading after rebounds; KRW FX.
catalyst: HBM4 volume with Nvidia/AMD; Q4 pricing.

name: Vertiv
thesis: Liquid cooling and power for AI racks; 800V DC sidecars expected from 2H27.
risks: JPM resumed at Neutral with a $240 target; capex-cycle sensitivity.
catalyst: PowerNexus medium-voltage UPS for AI sites launched Nov 12; liquid-cooling orders.

name: Bloom Energy
thesis: On-site fuel-cell power for data centers that can't wait for a grid connection.
risks: Very volatile (+13% Nov 11); depends on data-center sentiment; SoftBank changed its US data-center plans.

name: GE Vernova
thesis: Gas turbine backlog sold out for years; JPM says it can weather an AI capex slowdown.
risks: SoftBank changing its US data-center plans hit the shares Nov 10; JPM trimmed its target to $1,000.
catalyst: Turbine slot reservations; Dec investor update.

name: Robinhood
thesis: Record equity activity as customers bought dips; adding prediction markets, agentic tools, wealth and RIAs.
risks: Crypto slump and tougher rules signalled in Congress; trading revenue is cyclical.

name: MercadoLibre
risks: Brazil political risk; JPM and UBS cut targets (to $1,850 and $1,600), both Neutral; margins pressured by investment.

name: Cloudflare
thesis: Q3 revenue $782.5M, +39% y/y; edge inference and agent traffic are a tailwind.
risks: Rich valuation; Guggenheim Sell (target as low as $190); DZ Bank upgraded to Buy, $300 target.

name: Sea Ltd
thesis: Shopee, Monee and Garena in SE Asia; Q3 revenue $8.6B beat estimates; $1B buyback.
risks: Q3 EPS miss; BofA ($110), TD Cowen ($90), StoneX ($155) and Barclays ($150) all cut targets Nov 11-12; Shopee spend stays high.

name: Keyence
thesis: Factory automation sensors with very high margins; Citi Buy; recovers when manufacturing capex turns.
risks: Slow China/industrial demand; JPY. No news this week.
catalyst: Manufacturing PMI recovery; next results late Jan.

name: ASML Holding
thesis: EUV monopoly; raised 2026 guidance on AI capacity build; buyback running.
risks: Down about 20% over the past month; China export limits; execution risk.

name: Teradyne
thesis: Moving from mobile testing to AI chip test; Jefferies initiated at Buy ($284 target) and sees a $2B Nvidia opportunity.
risks: Nvidia leadership turmoil; robotics unit still weak; +8.3% day may be stretched.
catalyst: AI compute test share gains; Omnyx Edge launch.
